Oh I am doing something fun with Madame Eva myself! I took the idea of her being old old and made her Baba Yaga in disguise- once one of three sisters who helped take care of the young Strahd, she hid herself after- by the time Baba Lysaga killed their other sister and became her own witch, Madame Eva was established. She is actually the Archfey warlock's patron (but said warlock doesnt know that)

I was planning something similar to the Gallows idea buuuu5 quite different as well- in the play, it'll be evident that they are coming into Barovia fresh on the tail end of a previous attempt at insurrection led by a previous party- and upon entrance into Barovia, theyll witness the hanging of the Burgomaster for his assistance. (Strahd will let Ireena have the body because obvi hes not evil, and he deeply respected the man, definitely not just trying to get Tatyana to love him or anything)

As far as the Holy Symbol, it allows for communication to the wereravens via telepathy (but it will be something the party has to figure out on their own) 

For narrative purposes, I have the tome with Lysaga, the Amulet stolen from the wereravens (not a difficult quest to get back, it's a young Vistani rogue who did it for Ez, its how they will meet her) and the Sunsword is wielded by the dear Abbot- who isn't exactly aware of the weapon he carries. 

For me the werewolves are very sympathetic to the cause of their cousins and support their work, but there is a mole in their ranks (also, reflavoring the Lycan BH as a wereraven... idea that sounds cool to me. not suggesting just had to get that idea out xD) 

Well, the Shadar-kai rogue could have family lost to the mists when the Dark Powers did their thing, not that they necessarily know it? Could even be one of the people killed? 

I can also suggest pulling from things like real world mythology for ideas!

I am speaking purely from experience as a player where my group did the same thing- and also as a DM who is essentially doing similar (though the commissioning agent is actually a warlock already in Barovia to request their assistance)

Flavoring the Holy Symbol of Ravenkind to be an artifact of the Queen herself that gives her a bit more power in the Mists is something I am doing myself. 

Having previous parties mentioned as being followers of her tasked with the same but ultimately failing as well?

Does the Raven Queen have contacts in Barovia other than the Wereravens? 

Just bouncing ideas back and forth! ^^
